title: Restriction after coordinate assignment
statement: Let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction, let $C$ be a list of coordinates, and let $s,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Fixing the coordinates in $C$ according to the values of $x$ gives the same restriction whether those values are read directly from $x$ or from the vector obtained by updating $s$ on $C$ with the corresponding values of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a list of coordinates
s and x are Boolean-cube vectors
